output.title: Acme Pricing Call
output.overview: Aman and Rahul met with Vikram from Acme to discuss pricing for 50 support team seats. Because Acme requires single sign-on prior to a full rollout, both parties agreed to initiate a 10-seat pilot on December 1st while SSO is planned for Q1. Action items were established for providing the SSO roadmap, sending the pilot contract, and securing internal budget confirmation.

decisions.text: Run a 10-seat pilot starting on December 1st.

action_items.task: Confirm the budget with the finance team before signing
